candidates: A window exists but is unspecified in this schedule
ambiguities.reason: The contract requires the seller payout reversal to precede the refund but specifies no time window within which the reversal must occur.
ambiguities.source_quote: Where a customer refund is issued, the Seller payout shall first be reversed. Commission is refundable.

commission.source_quote: The Seller shall receive seventy-five percent (75%) of the Net Order Value. The balance is retained by the Platform as its commission.

delivery_fee.source_quote: No delivery partner fee applies to this agreement.

hold.source_quote: The Seller's share shall be settled on the next settlement cycle following payment capture. Delivery confirmation is not a precondition to settlement under this agreement.

promotion_funding.source_quote: Discounts shall be funded 50% by the Platform and 50% by the Seller.

provenance.notes: SYNTHETIC contract corpus — not a real merchant agreement.

refund.source_quote: Where a customer refund is issued, the Seller payout shall first be reversed. Commission is refundable.

tax.source_quote: No tax shall be withheld at source under this agreement.
